scientific_role: Attach one fixed development lifecycle to every immutable V37 event after its outcome-blind representation, opportunity, stability and redundancy gates passed. This is a mother-signal economic screen, not a portfolio replay, chart-rule search or validation.
economic_horizon_rationale: V37 measures a 120-session stock exposure to causal innovations in aggregate market realized volatility. The fixed 20-session lifecycle tests whether the frozen risk-compensation ranking has economically useful one-month payoff. The +10% target and 40 bp round-trip cost are inherited unchanged from the accepted V36 mother-signal attachment rather than selected from V37 outcomes.

signal_scope.signal_time: The exact completed month-end signal-session close recorded in each immutable candidate decision_at.

outcome_data.maximum_event_path: Exactly the first 126 global market sessions strictly after each frozen signal, additionally capped at 2021-09-30.
outcome_data.2021_role: Path-completion buffer only for frozen events whose signal year is 2020. No 2021 signal or candidate may enter, and no event may consume a row beyond signal_cal_idx+126.
outcome_data.coordinate_construction: Raw OHLC geometry is checked exactly first. Adjusted OHLC is formed as adjusted_close*(raw_price/raw_close), preserving ratio-first geometry without clipping, normalization or tolerance relaxation.
outcome_data.path_completeness: The date cap must contain at least 126 global sessions after the latest signal. Every event must receive exactly 126 global calendar slots. Missing candidate rows or coordinate joins fail closed; execution-invalid rows remain explicit and are never dropped.

outcome_attachment.entry: Inspect global market sessions signal+1 through signal+3 in order. Fill at the first legal, fully valid, non-upper-limit adjusted-coordinate open. Never fill on the signal bar.
outcome_attachment.target: The first later same-lineage legal adjusted-coordinate high at least 1.10 times entry exits at exactly +10% gross, subject to the frozen sellability check.
outcome_attachment.fallback: At the first same-lineage row with cal_idx strictly greater than entry_cal_idx+20, process the open before same-day high. Exit at target if sellable open is at or above target; otherwise exit at adjusted-coordinate open. Only an unsellable open may defer to a later same-day legal target touch.

development_gate.if_failed: Close this exact V37 strategy-usefulness claim on consumed 2018-2020 development outcomes. Do not rescue the sign, target, horizon, entry window, cohort, threshold or execution rule.
development_gate.if_passed: Classify only as a development candidate. Any chart review, rule synthesis, portfolio replay or later-period opening requires a separate result-blind freeze and authorization.

required_outputs.publication: Same-parent temporary construction, complete execution and identity audits, re-hash every bound input and revalidate public authorization, then one atomic no-overwrite rename.

prohibited: changing V37 score, direction, regression, schedule, industry winner, cooldown, event identity, candidate membership or annual cohort
same-bar entry, entry after signal+3, target/horizon/cost search, stop search or alternate execution
2021 signals, 2021 rows for pre-2020-signal events, any row after signal+126 or 2021-09-30, or any 2022-plus read
charts, manual labels, rule construction, feature thresholds, portfolio replay, market-state filter, strategy combination or later-period validation
alternate-sign interpretation or rescue after the result
